description: This file provides a lightweight API client wrapper for making HTTP requests to a backend service. It includes functions to retrieve the base API URL from environment variables and to perform fetch requests with automatic handling of headers, error responses, and content types.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables, trimming trailing slashes, or returns an empty string if not configured.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP fetch to the specified API path, using the base URL if configured. Handles errors and content types, throwing descriptive errors or returning JSON/text as appropriate.
